display.purpose: Rare large serif; not Home chrome.

motion.name: material-standard
motion.purpose: Use Material motion; honor Remove animations.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #6366F1; color: #fff; min-height: 52px; padding: 14px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font: 500 16px/24px system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #27272A; color: #E4E4E7; min-height: 52px; padding: 14px 20px; border: 1px solid #3F3F46; border-radius: 8px; font: 500 16px/24px system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Outlined Field
components.css: .ds-field { width: 100%; background: #18181B; color: #E4E4E7; border: 1px solid #3F3F46; border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; font: 16px/24px ui-monospace, monospace; }

components.name: Highlight Mark
components.css: .ds-copy { color: #A1A1AA; font: 16px/26px system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: center; } .ds-mark { background: #FDE047; color: #000; font-weight: 500; padding: 0 0.25em; }

narrative.overview: Chrome is the webapp login: zinc, indigo, yellow marks, short sans type. The article is a book: Source Serif 4, justified body, little else on the page. Identity is optional and must never look more important than reading.
keyCharacteristics: Zinc surfaces, indigo filled actions, 8dp corners
Yellow marks only on Home copy
Source Serif for reading; sans for chrome

rules.name: The Two Loud Colors Rule
rules.body: Indigo is for actions. Yellow is for marks. Do not add a third accent.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Do not add drop shadows to Home or the reader.

dos: Do keep Home copy identical to the webapp, including the two yellow marks.
Do use Amber / Signer / Read as the Android button labels.
Do theme through Material color roles in BorisTheme.
donts: Don't put an nsec field anywhere.
Don't invent bookmarks, highlights, or social chrome on Android.
Don't use Inter-as-brand, purple gradients, glassmorphism, or nested cards.
